proposedEntry.name: better-accessibility
proposedEntry.description: Accessibility engineering guidance for building or reviewing UI components and custom widgets: native-element-first ARIA rules, exact focus-ring and tabindex/roving-tabindex recipes, WCAG 2.5.8 hit-area sizing with pseudo-element expansion, form labeling and error-announcement patterns, prefers-reduced-motion and autoplay/zoom rules, live-region and screen-reader announcement selection, alt-text-by-purpose table, and a calibrated HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW severity report format ending in Block/Approve.
inputs: UI component or screen source code
outputs: severity-ranked findings table (Severity | Location | Before | After | Why)
verification checklist with Not verified items flagged
